verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents programmatic REST and SQL APIs with official OpenAPI specifications. It also runs a first-party behavior-change announcement process with dated bundles meant to minimize disruption, which partly covers a documented change and deprecation process. The pack does not show explicit API version identifiers or a formal deprecation timeline or policy for those APIs. missing for 10: explicit API versioning scheme, documented API deprecation policy with notice periods/sunset timelines, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: To help you manage your operations and minimize disruption to your Snowflake service, we document behavior changes that may impact your usage
These REST APIs are compliant with the OpenAPI specification.
Snowflake REST APIs for resource management provide a set of endpoints that lets users programmatically interact with and control various resources within the Snowflake Data Cloud.
